description: List blog categories for a location, optionally filtered by blog.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

blogId.description: Blog ID to filter categories by

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return

locationId.description: Location ID to list categories for

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

offset.description: Number of categories to skip for pagination

name: crm_list_blog_categories
